_note: Per coastal id: every part of every chained sub-object (descriptor +4 'next' link, document 35's FUN_0041afb0), with its cel, flags, the link descriptor's local (x,y) offset (+0x14/+0x18) and 4 real local-space corners in WORLD UNITS (raw 16.16 / 65536; tile = 32 units). Axes: x=width, y=length (+y = screen down), z=height. Ids 49/50 (part_count 0) use the angle-bucket path: parts are those named by bucket list 0 (decorations always use bucket 0). Id 76 (corner_count 0, unused by every level) is not extracted. Per part also: 'zoff' (descriptor +0x1c, world units; 0 when flags byte +0x10 has bit 0x10) and 'jitter' (descriptor callback +0x28 == 0x4365c0, the per-tile position jitter of document 44).
